form_subtitle_transaction: Propose a treasury transfer from the realm vault.
form_subtitle_upgrade: Install or upgrade a codex, extension, or core orchestration action.
form_subtitle_poll: Ask the realm a question — no automated action if approved.
form_subtitle_code_execution: Submit Python code to run on the realm backend if approved.
no_proposals_filtered: No proposals match the current filters
effective_at_hint: Optional. Without it, the proposal runs as soon as it is accepted. With it, it runs at this time, in the realm's official time ({zone}), and never earlier; if voting ends after this time, it expires and nothing runs. The time cannot change once the proposal is accepted, so leave a margin.
effective_at_gap: This time does not exist in {zone}: the clocks go forward then. Choose another.
effective_at_twice: This time happens twice in {zone}, because the clocks go back: {first} and {second}. Choose another.
effective_at_invalid: Enter a date and a time.
effective_at_past: The time it takes effect must be in the future
stop_explain: This proposal was accepted and is waiting for its time to take effect. Stopping it ends it as withdrawn: its action will never run. Where a department's policy needs a vote, this files a proposal to stop it.
stop_done: Proposal {id} is stopped: its action will never run.
stop_filed: A stop proposal was filed: {id}. This proposal stops once that one is accepted.
links_hint: Optional. Links are fixed when the proposal is filed, at most {max} in all.
links_replaces_none: You have no withdrawn proposal to replace
links_replaces_help: One of your withdrawn proposals that no other proposal replaces yet.
links_full: A proposal has at most {max} links.
links_bad_ref: Type a proposal number, such as 12.
vote_can_change: You can change your vote until voting ends.
vote_is_final: Voting has ended, so your vote can no longer change.
waiting_one: Waiting for 1 more voter or the deadline
waiting_many: Waiting for {count} more voters or the deadline
waiting_one_open: Waiting for 1 more voter, or until the outcome is certain
waiting_many_open: Waiting for {count} more voters, or until the outcome is certain
waiting_department_open: Waiting for {what}: it stays open until it passes or everyone has voted
waiting_cast_open: Waiting for {what}: it stays open until everyone has voted
waiting_quorum: enough votes to reach the quorum
waiting_vetoed: a veto holder to change their no
requirement_unknown: Requirement: not recorded for this proposal
rule_cast: more than {threshold}% yes of the yes and no votes cast
rule_eligible: more than {threshold}% yes of all eligible members, whether they vote or not
rule_department: {approvals} of the policy's {seats} seats must vote yes
rule_abstain: abstentions and members who do not vote count against it
rule_veto: no veto holder may vote no
rule_quorum: at least {quorum}% of the eligible members must vote
rule_casting: a tie at the threshold goes to the yes of the casting vote ({who})
rule_abstain_not_counted: abstentions do not count towards the majority
rule_abstain_quorum: abstentions count towards the quorum, not the majority
rule_quorum_seats: at least {count} of the policy's {seats} seats must vote
rule_second_vote: a tie at the threshold goes to a second vote
rule_casting_second: a tie at the threshold in the second vote goes to the yes of the casting vote ({who})
rule_second_tie_rejects: a tie at the threshold in the second vote rejects it
casting_decides: Yes and no are tied at the threshold: the yes of the casting vote ({who}) decides it, if they are still a member.
casting_needs: Yes and no are tied at the threshold: it passes only with a yes from the casting vote ({who}).
tie_again_rejects: Yes and no are tied at the threshold again, and the vote has no casting vote: a tie rejects it.
casting_second_decides: Yes and no are tied at the threshold again: the yes of the casting vote ({who}) decides it, if they still hold a seat.
casting_second_needs: Yes and no are tied at the threshold again: it passes only with a yes from the casting vote ({who}).
ended_exceeds: the yes votes exceed the threshold
ended_not_exceeds: the yes votes do not exceed the threshold
ended_casting: yes and no are tied at the threshold, and the casting vote decides it, if its holder is still a member
ended_second_vote: yes and no are tied at the threshold, so a second vote follows
ended_tie_expires: yes and no are tied at the threshold, but the vote ended after the time the proposal takes effect, so it expires instead of going to a second vote
ended_tied_again: yes and no are tied at the threshold again, and without a yes from the casting vote it is rejected
ended_casting_second: yes and no are tied at the threshold again, and the casting vote decides it, if its holder still holds a seat
rule_department_one: the policy's 1 seat must vote yes
second_vote: Second vote: the first vote ended in a tie ({yes} yes, {no} no, {abstain} abstain), so the proposal was put to a second vote under the same rule. The first vote's ballots were deleted: everyone votes again.
second_vote_short: Second vote, after a tied first vote
release_install: Installs release {version} of {source} whole. The realm builds the change list from the record of the sync source that vouches for it when the install runs.
release_step_back: This takes the realm back: {source} {version} is older than {runs}, the release the realm runs now. The source went back to it.
change_unreadable: The change list cannot be shown: {reason}
change_invalid: This is not a change list the realm reads.
fetch_unreachable: The address could not be read from this browser. The realm's pages read only from some hosts.
fetch_too_large: The file is larger than the limit for a file of its kind.
fetch_wrong_bytes: The file at the address is not the one the proposal pins.
change_no_summary: The change list gives no summary.
change_stale: The change list was made for codex {replaces}, but the realm now runs {running}: the install would be refused as stale.
report_label: Not checked by the realm. Whoever made this proposal attached the report. This page checked only that the file below is the one the change list names, never what it says.
report_none: The proposal has no analysis report.
